--- title: reference_years --- ```python reference_years(dataset, variable=None, scale=None, ref=None) ``` The actual years behind each stored year, one row per variable and stored year. Some panels store values at nominal years: the SDG Atlas, for example, stores its initial values at 2012 and its final values at 2024, while an indicator may come from a survey of 2008 and 2023. ## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters} | Name | Type | Description | Default | |----------|-------------|------------------------------------------------------------|------------| | dataset | str | Dataset id | _required_ | | variable | str \| None | One variable (default: all) | `None` | | scale | str \| None | The resource's scale (default: the dataset's native scale) | `None` | ## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns} | Name | Type | Description | |--------|------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | | pandas.DataFrame | Columns ``variable``, ``label``, ``year`` (as stored) and ``reference`` (the actual years; the stored year when they are the same). | ## Example {.doc-section .doc-section-example} ```python !pip install -q geo4bolivia import geo4bolivia as geo import plotly.express as px ry = geo.reference_years("sdg03") # stored year -> actual years ry[ry["year"] == 2024] ``` ::: {.g4-example-links} [Open a blank Colab notebook to run it](https://colab.research.google.com/notebooks/empty.ipynb) ::: ::: {#3007c112 .cell execution_count=1} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ```{=html}
